mapper.select: SELECT fa.id, fa.project_id, gj.job_id AS generation_job_id, fa.storage_key, fa.mime_type, fa.size_bytes, fa.checksum_sha256, fa.duration_ms, fa.width, fa.height, fa.fps::int AS fps, fa.status FROM final_artifacts fa JOIN projects p ON p.id = fa.project_id JOIN generation_jobs gj ON gj.id = fa.generation_job_id WHERE fa.project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND gj.job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND gj.job_type = 'RENDER_PROJECT' AND fa.artifact_type = 'PROJECT_VIDEO' AND p.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND fa.status = 'READY' LIMIT 1
